problem_statement: Instructors and administrators need a simple, open-access tool to collect and review course feedback without complex login systems or multi-page navigation. The app must allow students to submit feedback with required fields (course name, instructor name, rating, category, feedback text) and provide aggregated summaries and a list of all feedback entries via API endpoints.

personas.name: Dr. Emily Carter
goals: Collect anonymous feedback from students to improve teaching
Quickly view summary statistics (e.g., average rating per category) without navigating multiple pages
Access raw feedback data for detailed review
frustrations: Existing feedback systems require login and multi-step processes
Wastes time on administrative overhead instead of focusing on teaching
Overly complex dashboards with irrelevant features

personas.name: Alex Johnson
goals: Submit honest feedback about courses quickly and easily
Ensure my feedback is recorded with correct course and instructor details
Complete feedback in one go without account creation or extra steps
frustrations: Long, multi-page feedback forms that discourage participation
Systems that require login or personal information, reducing anonymity
Confusing category options that don't match my experience

requirements: Open-access, no login or authentication required
Allow students to submit feedback with required fields: course_name, instructor_name, rating, category, feedback_text
Provide an API endpoint to list all feedback entries
Provide an API endpoint to return aggregated summary statistics (e.g., average rating per category)
Category field limited to: Teaching, Assessment, Materials, Pace, Engagement

user_stories.goal: Collect anonymous feedback from students to improve teaching
user_stories.scenario: As an instructor, I want to use a simple tool where students can submit feedback without logging in, so that I get honest responses and can quickly view summary statistics.

user_stories.goal: Quickly view summary statistics without navigating multiple pages

user_stories.goal: Access raw feedback data for detailed review
user_stories.scenario: As an instructor, I want to retrieve a list of all feedback entries via an API endpoint, so I can analyze individual comments and ratings.

user_stories.goal: Submit honest feedback about courses quickly and easily
user_stories.scenario: As a student, I want to fill out a short form without creating an account, so I can provide my feedback in one go and feel that my voice is heard.

user_stories.goal: Ensure my feedback is recorded with correct course and instructor details
user_stories.scenario: As a student, I want to enter the course name and instructor name accurately in the form, so my feedback is attributed correctly.

user_stories.goal: Complete feedback in one go without account creation or extra steps
user_stories.scenario: As a student, I want to submit feedback via a simple page without login or multi-step navigation, so I can finish quickly and anonymously.
